author: @PrivacyScrubber
comment: Shadow AI is inevitable, so we stopped fighting it and started securing the prompt locally. We use PrivacyScrubber for Zero-Trust Data Sanitization. Since it runs in the browser RAM with no backend, we can verify that no original PII ever hits the LLM servers. CISOs should check out the 'ZTDS' approach—it's much easier than a total ban.

author: @tracyrreed
comment:
Also, cybersecurity is not a new field.

Cyber is a very old and mature field. It may be new to you but I've been in "cyber" for 30 years. Consider this:

Bob Thomas wrote the Creeper virus in 1971

The movie War Games (made "war dialing" famous) was released in 1983

The first of the Rainbow Series, 5200.28-STD DoD Trusted Computer System Evaluation Criteria, aka The Orange Book, was published in 1983

The first hacker con called the "The Hackers Conference" was in 1984. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Hackers_Conference

The first commercial antivirus software was created in 1987 by a company called McAfee

The book the Cuckoo’s Egg was published in 1989

The ISC2 was founded in 1989

The first DEFCON was in 1993.

So cybersecurity is a 40+ year old industry.
